classification: FIT-ONLY ORIGINAL EXTERNAL SOURCE; no DEV or protected first-use
training: Run actually original source with existing authenticated C29 public collector for every physical action; only when original PUBLIC door-open event has occurred, record post-door public 7x7 image/direction, selected action, actual reward and original goal termination. Use only genuine source reward-positive complete episodes as delayed reward-bearing demonstrations; source-native candidate and independent learned conventional see identical logged source events; no hidden grid or map.
native_candidate: Independent research-native local synaptic cell table of per-action discounted successful post-door source returns keyed by reduced public local 7x7 appearance, current direction and public carry status. No handcoded stage or route selection after door. Fit only from real source after-door positive-reward action sequences with original reward-derived Monte Carlo 0.97 per subsequent action, Laplace shrinkage. Never call owner R12 as postdoor planner.
conventional_control: Independently coded full-public-image context/action Monte Carlo return lookup with identical actual source training episodes/discount and global return-aware backoff. Same public fields, no oracle. Strong handcoded original C29 collector retained as baseline.
source_r10_adapter: Original exactly pinned R10 public image/direction/mission; conversion of original numpy direction to Python int in bounded adapter. Never call env.unwrapped, env.grid, env.agent_pos, private carrying, state or source seed in any policy.
qualification: Only validate if original source produced at least one true terminal positive reward in source training and at least one previously real post-door trained action. This is training feasibility, not evidence of success.
validation: In new separate original FIT validation seeds, use exactly same original C29 public collector until FIRST actually observed source door opening, then delegate ALL remaining actions to trained native local or independent conventional learned return tables. The collector baseline continues unchanged. Each arm resets its original source episode, runs genuine source actions, no invented next observations. Compare per-arm actual goal counts and action cost, post-door delegated actions, collector baseline, resource costs. No manual after-door stage selection except identifying first actual door event for isolating learned policy.
cold: Canonical SHA256 checked complete native and conventional fitted tables, fresh Python OS process restore same next public decision at first postdoor public state
repro: Two independent full original-source runs exact trajectories, scientific outcomes and checkpoint hashes identical; CPU timing excluded from equality
stopping: No learned navigation claim if native remains no better than a fully trained conventional or handcoded collector. Source failure or positive-return absence stops before validation; preserve negatives, no threshold searches, no DEV/protected first use.
governance: Independent Mass Research DRAFT only, no owner R10/R11/R12 change, no FORGE/CKB plane controller, no paid API, no ChatGPT Library
